info.name: C2C Vehicle Platform API
info.description:
All APIs are POST-only. Base: /api/v1

**Quick start**
1. Import `C2C-Local.postman_environment.json`
2. Run folders in order (00 → 12)
3. Login scripts auto-save tokens & IDs
4. Amounts are in **cents** (€45000 = 4500000)
5. Re-login as buyer/vendor when switching roles

**Happy path:** Register → Verify → Admin login → Create make/model → Vendor login → Create listing → Admin approve → Buyer offer → Vendor accept → Payment
